description:
Make the SOURCE COPY the pump reads: pg_dump of `source_db` on `source_host` (read-only on
    the source; a native Odoo database), restored into the TARGET's PostgreSQL cluster as
    `source_copy_db` (default `<source_db>_src`). Same box (production next to a Docker target):
    dumped and restored locally. Two boxes: relayed through this agent with sha256 checked end to
    end (the dump holds personal data: 600 files, removed afterwards).

    An existing copy with that name is replaced (dropdb --force - a running service may hold it).
    The copy may never have the source's own name. Takes minutes for a large database.
name: data_pump_source
